name: Takiguchi Itsuki
source:
Younger classmate of protagonist. Joined the tea club but mostly just lazes around. He has a reputation as being a slut. Claims his favorite targets are a straight men that he corrupts. After protag shows some reaction to traps he decides to make him his new target.

[spoiler]Is forced to cross dress because of his mom as young kid. He was constantly being picked on and being bullied because of it. When he got older nicer older men took notice eventual leading to sex. He had a revelation that through sex he could control men and get revenge making them act like pathetic slaves. Every time he got some to fall he felt stronger and not so helpless like when he was as a kid. He never felt sexual pleasure from sex but feelings of success until he meet the protag.[/spoiler]
